title: Skip Prologue — Mortal Shell II
description: How to unlock and decide whether to use the optional Prologue skip in Mortal Shell II; what you keep or lose and the official Steam fix for missing rewards.
quickAnswer: How to skip: Progress beyond Marrow Keep in the Open Beta, then choose the optional Prologue skip during the full-game start flow if the unlock is present. Should you skip: first-time and completion-focused players should normally play the Prologue; returning Beta players who value speed can consider the option. What you miss/keep: the skip bypasses two confirmed Prologue trophy opportunities (Mid Summer? and No, You Still Can't Win) and does not transfer Beta inventory—Beta currency, weapons, Shells, collectibles, and other discovered items reset. If a Steam unlock is missing, follow the developer-confirmed Steam workaround below.

faq.question: How do I unlock the optional Prologue skip?
faq.answer: According to store copy, progressing beyond Marrow Keep in the Open Beta unlocks the skip; later Steam developer replies also say roughly 30+ minutes in the Open Beta qualifies for The Flayed Harbinger and the Prologue skip. Both first-party claims are reported and preserved here.

faq.question: Will my Open Beta progress, items, or Shells transfer if I use the skip?
faq.answer: No. The skip is not a Beta save transfer: Beta currency, weapons, Shells, collectibles, and other discovered items reset and do not carry into the full game.

faq.question: Which Prologue trophies/opportunities are bypassed by the skip?
faq.answer: Two confirmed Prologue trophy opportunities are bypassed: Mid Summer? (the flower crown / Festival interaction) and No, You Still Can't Win (take the Prologue Tar Golem to minimum health).

faq.question: Does New Game Plus replay the Prologue trophies if I skipped earlier?
faq.answer: No. New Game Plus begins at Marrow Keep and does not replay those Prologue opportunities.

faq.question: What should I do if the Prologue skip or Beta rewards are not appearing on Steam?
faq.answer: Use the developer-confirmed Steam workaround in the Steam section below: confirm the same Steam account, relaunch the full game once, ensure the Open Beta remains in your Steam Library, and follow the reinstall/pause step if needed.

articleMarkdown:
If a Steam unlock is missing, use the developer-confirmed workaround below before trying community fixes or support.

### Steam: Prologue Skip or Beta Reward Not Showing

This is a developer-confirmed Steam workaround for detection/entitlement issues. Follow these steps in order:

1. Confirm you used the same Steam account for the Open Beta.
2. Exit and relaunch the full game once.
3. Make sure Mortal Shell II Open Beta is still added to the Steam Library.
4. Relaunch the full game.
5. If the unlock still does not register, developer guidance says to start reinstalling the Beta, then pause the install around 7%, and relaunch the full game.
6. Once the rewards appear in the full game, the Beta can be uninstalled.

The developer's pinned Known Issues also lists having the Beta present in the Library or partially installed as a workaround. This is entitlement detection/troubleshooting only: it does not restore the Beta save, weapons, Shells, currency, collectibles, or other Beta progress.

Eligibility note: store copy states progressing beyond Marrow Keep unlocks the optional Prologue skip; later Steam developer replies say roughly 30+ minutes in the Open Beta qualifies for The Flayed Harbinger and the Prologue skip. Both first-party claims are reported here and are not reconciled.
